svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Destroying motion while keeping appearance
svg.desc: The same frames in their true order and shuffled. Each frame is kept and only the order changes, so timing-dependent features of a method that measures movement should change.
svg.text: time) change or stop passing the check;
If its processing ignores frame order, its
output barely moves: the person, clothing
and age cues are all still there.
Shaded frames show the person risen onto the toes (head above the dashed line). Every tool output is recomputed on the shuffled video.
